author: Wintergatan
description:
Episode 406

Todays stream is a bit different as we are missing one of our most important pieces of tech to run the stream so: Today we are only streaming to youtube, the multistreaming to twitch and X will be back tomorrow. We are also streaming in lower res compared to the 4K of our normal program, 4K returns tomorrow. Please bare with us for any other tech issues today!

Derek shared great information with me regarding sketching on mate connectors & Amalgamante for repetitive tasks:

Evan Reese primer on Mate Connectors:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VM81Wm9PIds

Forum Discussion:
https://forum.onshape.com/discussion/17499/mate-connectors-vs-planes-why-oh-why

Evan Reese two videos on Amalgamate:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=An1ovqp_NrM
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SM0p7w5K3UI

Thanks to both Derek and Evan for sharing incredibly useful info with us all.
